excerpts: FastSpring’s team will work with you to determine simple, flat-rate pricing based on transaction type and your volume of business
Our pricing works on a revenue-sharing model and our fees vary depending on the transaction volume you move through FastSpring.
Pricing is typically based on volume of sales and custom rates can be negotiated in conversation with our Sales team.
why_not: The page is a pricing page, but it states no price a small shop can read: it says 'One flat rate. No hidden fees.' without giving any number, and says pricing is set in conversation with sales, varies by transaction volume, and custom rates are negotiated. Its FAQ says fees are 'best discussed during a meeting with an Account Executive', so the owner must go elsewhere for the actual number.
